entities.name: Mastercard Commerce Media
entities.description: Mastercard's commerce media solution powered by Genuin, designed to fast track adoption and maximize margin with every media impression across owned channels and the partner network.

entities.name: Mastercard
entities.description: Global payments organization partnering with Genuin to deploy a scaled and differentiated commerce media solution aligned with its 'Priceless' brand.

entities.name: Brand Control Center
entities.description: AI-powered platform that augments internal planning and activation teams to orchestrate media delivery and outcomes with automation and efficiency.

entities.name: Genuin Network
entities.description: Scaled distribution network of premium publisher and retail media O&O sites and apps, reaching 237MM users with 4B impressions/month and 8MM+ logged-in users across 100MM+ devices.

entities.name: Video Feed Takeover
entities.description: Upfront sponsorship format delivering carousel, grid, feed, and popup placements across the partner network, including homepage and post-checkout takeovers.

entities.name: Carousel Format
entities.description: Personalized video carousel placement embedded within partner properties to drive engagement across the customer journey.

entities.name: Feed Format
entities.description: Embedded video community feed format that drives onsite engagement, sales, and media revenue for retailers and publishers.

entities.name: Grid Format
entities.description: High-impact grid placement format compatible across apps, mobile web, and desktop.

entities.name: Standard Wall Format
entities.description: Standard wall placement embedded within partner properties for video content distribution.

entities.name: Popup Format
entities.description: Popup video format delivered across the network of partners.

entities.name: Homepage Takeover
entities.description: Premium placement takeover on partner homepages within the Genuin Network.

entities.name: Post-Checkout Takeover
entities.description: Video takeover placement triggered after consumer checkout within partner commerce flows.

entities.name: Identity Mapping
entities.description: Process that maps Genuin user ID to Mastercard user ID via LiveRamp, enabling 1:1 user-level video orchestration tied to credit card spend data.

entities.name: LiveRamp
entities.description: Identity resolution partner that maps Genuin user IDs to Mastercard user IDs to enable identity-mapped programmatic activation across the network.

entities.name: Programmatic Video Ad Units
entities.description: Identity-mapped video ad units (300x600 and 300x250) activated programmatically via exchanges to curate and activate merchant-specific dealIDs.

entities.name: IAB Compatible Video Feed
entities.description: Contextually continuous personalized IAB-compatible video feed scaled across premium publisher and retail media sites and apps.

entities.name: Raw Logs Data Delivery
entities.description: Capability that returns all raw logs of serving data back to the client's existing data infrastructure to enrich identity-level data and measurement.

entities.name: Priceless Brand
entities.description: Mastercard's brand platform that the offsite media experience aligns with, designed to build a more connected experience for all merchants.

entities.name: Priceless Planet Initiative
entities.description: Mastercard sustainability initiative referenced as an example for merchant advertising into aligned communities such as TED.

entities.name: Merchants
entities.description: Brands and merchant advertisers who use Mastercard Commerce Media to reach and distribute video assets to engaged audiences across the Genuin Network.

entities.name: Retailers and Publishers
entities.description: Retail, commerce, and publisher partners that embed video community feeds in owned channels to drive onsite engagement, sales, and media revenue.

entities.name: Shoppers
entities.description: End consumers who receive personalized feeds surfacing relevant content, offers, and social interaction across the Genuin Network.

entities.name: Creators and Influencers
entities.description: Content creators and influencers contributing organic content and ads that flow through the Genuin onsite audience network.

entities.name: Mastercard Merchant Network
entities.description: Network of Mastercard merchant partners across which media assets can be bartered while keeping dollars within the Mastercard ecosystem.

entities.name: TED Sustainability Community
entities.description: Sustainability community aligned with the Priceless Planet initiative cited as a merchant advertising example.

entities.name: Credit Card Spend Data
entities.description: Mastercard credit card spend signal linked to video distribution to enable 1:1 user-level feed orchestration across the Genuin network.

entities.name: Commerce Media Initiative
entities.description: Mastercard's strategic initiative to fast track a scaled and differentiated commerce media solution that diversifies ROI and transforms marketing costs into revenues.
